snippet.title: Dupery: Demo Trailer 🔎
snippet.description:
A terrible syndicate has infiltrated society, explore cases, listen to what the people have to say, and use that information to route out the good from the evil in this ‘clock-like’ deduction game.

Can you uncover the head of the syndicate? Or will you be duped like the rest?

Find the demo on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845070/Dupery/
